title: Roasted Peppers

media.caption: Roast the peppers on a cast-iron grill
Cut them in half and remove the seeds

healthBenefits.title: Rich in Vitamin C
healthBenefits.text: Yellow and red peppers are an excellent source of vitamin C, supporting immune function and collagen production.

healthBenefits.title: Heart-Healthy Fats
healthBenefits.text: Extra virgin olive oil provides monounsaturated fats that help maintain healthy cholesterol levels and reduce inflammation.

healthBenefits.title: Omega-3 Source
healthBenefits.text: Anchovies contribute omega-3 fatty acids, which support cardiovascular and brain health.

healthBenefits.title: Mineral Boost
healthBenefits.text: Capers and anchovies add trace minerals like iron and calcium, though they also contribute sodium, so portion control is key.

healthBenefits.title: Antioxidant Herbs
healthBenefits.text: Oregano contains antioxidant compounds such as carvacrol, which have antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties.

healthBenefits.title: Eye Health Support
healthBenefits.text: The carotenoids in peppers, including beta-carotene, promote healthy vision and skin.

_ingredientsText:
2 yellow and red peppers
½ tablespoon of salted capers
1 teaspoon of oregano
3 salted anchovies
2 tablespoons of extra virgin olive oil
salt
_preparationText:
1 - Arrostire i peperoni su una griglia di ghisa
2 - Dividerli eliminando i semi
3 - tagliali a piccole fette 
4 - condisci con olio
5 - sale 
6 - capperi
7 - origano 
8 - acciughe sotto sale lavate
